entries.0f393cfbc09afee2: Starting from salt electrolysis and naphtha pyrolysis, the company manufactures basic chemicals such as caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer and resin, cement, MDI as a urethane raw material, ethylene and propylene, and polyethylene. In addition, it provides electronic materials such as quartz glass and sputtering targets, separation and purification agents used in purification processes for biopharmaceuticals, measurement and diagnostic products, and water treatment equipment.
entries.127df9c1039f7b85: The business manufactures and sells inorganic and organic fine products, measurement and diagnostic products, electronic materials (quartz glass, sputtering targets), functional materials and others. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥272,858 million (up 0.9% year on year). Shipments of ethyleneamines were flat year on year, and selling prices fell due to lower overseas market prices and the effect of exchange rates. For measurement-related products, shipments of liquid chromatography packing materials increased in the United States, while shipments of in vitro diagnostic pharmaceuticals for diagnostic-related products decreased in Japan and China. Shipments of high-silica zeolite increased for petrochemical applications in North America and for automotive applications in China and India, and shipments of zirconia increased for decorative applications and for dental applications in East Asia. Shipments of quartz glass decreased for semiconductor applications overseas, but the effect of an equipment accident in liquid crystal applications ended, so overall shipments increased. Shipments of sputtering targets increased overseas, and shipments of electrolytic manganese dioxide increased in Europe but decreased in Asia, so overall shipments decreased.
entries.1dc5fdc8ca049aa0: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, [[term:net-income-attributable-to-owners-of-parent|net income attributable to owners of the parent]] was ¥41,615 million, a decrease of ¥16.4 billion (28.3%) from ¥58,002 million in the previous year. The filing cites the recording of an impairment loss on the fixed assets of consolidated subsidiary Tosoh SMD, Inc., which manufactures and sells sputtering targets in the United States, as the reason for the decline in profit.

entries.5cf184695e462457: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,019,917 million, a decrease of 4.1% from the previous year. entries.644b5b3a3316b65b: This business manufactures and sells caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, vinyl chloride resin, inorganic and organic chemicals, cement and urethane raw materials, among others; it is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥345,967 million (down 7.4% year on year). Caustic soda and vinyl chloride monomer saw lower production and shipments due to differences in the scale of periodic repairs at the Nanyo Works. Shipments of vinyl chloride resin to overseas increased, and overseas selling prices of PVC products fell due to lower overseas market conditions. Cement shipments declined due to weak demand, but domestic selling prices rose. Shipments of MDI, a urethane raw material, were flat from the previous year, and selling prices fell due to lower overseas market conditions and the effect of exchange rates.

entries.bb97cba090b4e1b6: It treats the compatibility of 'growth' and 'decarbonization' as a medium- to long-term management issue. It divides its businesses into 2: the 'Chain Business', made up of product chains starting from salt electrolysis and naphtha cracking, and the 'Advanced Business', which handles advanced technologies and products with no direct link to other businesses in terms of facilities. It aims for stable and expanding earnings through higher added value of chlorine in the Chain Business and for an expanded earnings base through creating large new businesses in the Advanced Business; its medium-term management plan for fiscal 2025 to 2027 sets a target of reducing CO2 emissions by 30% in fiscal 2030 (compared with fiscal 2018) while pursuing decarbonization on all fronts.

entries.c3188b4f664f6d4f: The business manufactures and sells water treatment equipment and carries out construction and repair work. The core company is Organo Corporation, which manufactures and sells water treatment equipment, ultrapure water equipment, ion exchange resins and others. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥186,412 million (up 10.1% year on year). In the water treatment engineering business, plant projects related to semiconductors progressed well in Japan, Taiwan and the United States, and solution projects such as equipment-owning services and various maintenance services were also strong, so revenue increased. Revenue of the construction subsidiary also increased.

entries.d7b1213607f0e629: The business manufactures and sells olefin products such as ethylene and propylene, low-density polyethylene, high-density polyethylene, resin processed products, functional polymers and others. It operates the only naphtha cracker in the Chubu region. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥169,740 million (down 17.1% year on year). For ethylene and propylene, shipments decreased as demand within the complex declined, and selling prices fell due to lower naphtha prices. Shipments of cumene also decreased due to lower demand, and selling prices fell due to lower overseas market prices. For polyethylene resins, shipments of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) resin for semiconductor applications and low-density polyethylene (LDPE) resin for lamination remained firm, but demand for EVA resin for solar cell encapsulant films fell significantly, so overall shipments decreased. For chloroprene rubber, shipments decreased due to a delayed recovery in demand, but selling prices rose due to price revisions.
